answer: Seats are earned by escrowed work, not by wallet count. Each identity must post a bond; grading seats are drawn per epoch from that bonded set, and payout is released only after the grader's written rationale clears a hash-uniqueness check. A swarm of clones hits a ledge it cannot climb: bonds are refunded only at vesting, so a thousand sybils means a thousand locked stakes whose slashed remainder feeds the honest pool. Better to walk a narrow ridge of real graders than flood a dune of fake ones, because each fake seat costs stake and earns nothing.
